description: Grundvattentillgång i små magasin is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sveriges geologiska undersökning. The data set Groundwater supply in small reservoirs shows a calculation of groundwater supply for water supply in Sweden with a focus on small groundwater reservoirs. The calculation is based on a number of assumptions and a relatively general base material and is associated with uncertainties. Coverage: Sveriges geologiska undersökning. The portal shows the English title as "Groundwater supply in small reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sveriges geologiska undersökning. Its keywords include HVD. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, ZIP, PDF, 19139+XML. The listing shows 2024-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
